about_short_description.short_description: Almoosa Specialist Hospital is a private hospital and health system that promotes health and fights disease.

product.name: Inpatient Rehabilitation Program
product.description: A program providing multidisciplinary therapies to help patients recover from acute, relapse, or chronic conditions and regain functional independence.

product.name: Outpatient Care Services
product.description: Coordinated outpatient therapies including physical, occupational, respiratory, dietitian, psychology, and speech therapy to support ongoing patient recovery.

product.name: Long-Term Care Program
product.description: A program offering continuous personalized medical and therapeutic care in a home-like environment for patients requiring extended support.

product.name: Mental Health Inpatient Program
product.description: An inpatient program offering comprehensive psychiatric care including individual, group, family therapy, and medication management for mental health conditions.

product.name: Sports Injury Rehabilitation
product.description: Specialized rehabilitation services for sports-related injuries aimed at restoring function and enabling safe return to physical activities.

product.name: Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation
product.description: Rehabilitation services addressing injuries and disorders of the musculoskeletal system, including post-surgical recovery and personalized treatment plans.
